text: Raw paired-end FASTQ files available European Nucleotide Archive accession PRJEB97253. 79 entries total: 72 tumour sample × purity combinations across SPNs, plus 7 normal samples (one per SPN). entry contains files named tXX_{spn}_{sample}.R1.fastq.gz t00–t39 (40 bins × 5× = 200× total coverage per sample). text: Type (clones) Legend: Primary (P), Relapse (R), Number simulated clones (n), Number sampled time-points (t), Total number biopsies (b).

title: SCOUT cohort
text: SPN01 prototype micro-satellite stable (MSS) colorectal cancer composed 4 clones, one dominant clone sampling. dominant clone harbours full inactivation APC gene point mutation concurrent loss heterozygosity (LOH) wildtype allele, together two activating mutations TP53 tumour suppressor gene PIK3CA oncogene. SPN01 profiled multi-region 3 samples collected time-point.

title: SCOUT cohort
text: SPN02 prototype micro-satellite instable (MSI) colorectal cancer composed 3 clones, one dominant clone sampling. dominant clone harbours mutant BRAF, PIK3CA POLE. POLE mutation makes tumour hypermutant, enabling specific mutational signatures. SPN02 profiled multi-region 2 samples collected time-point.

title: SCOUT cohort
text: SPN03 prototype chronic lymphocitic leukemia composed 3 clones, eventually one largely dominant one still expanding. largest clone harbours activating mutations NOTCH1 TP53 deletion q-arm chromosome 13, last expanding subclone linked MAP2K1 mutation. SPN03 profiled watch--wait scenario (active survaillance scenario patient observed untill white blood counts exceed predefined threshould), acquiring one sample 4 time-points, distinct clonal compositions reflecting ongoing dynamics.

title: SCOUT cohort
text: SPN04 prototype acute myeloyd leukemia composed 3 clones, one becoming dominant every sampling. dominant clone harbours mutant IDH1, copy number gain MYC mutant NRAS. SPN04 profiled chemotherapy, relapsing clone presented treatment. Chemotherapy generates mutational signature specific exposure.

title: SCOUT cohort
text: SPN05 prototype mismatch-repair deficient breast cancer composed 5 clones, three detectable sampling. ancestral clone harbours mutant TP53, full BRCA2 inactivation joint mutation LOH (also linked specific mutational signature) tumour becomes hypermutant. two expanding subclones associated copy numbers: one ongoing TP53 LOH, CDKN2A LOH. SPN05 profiled single time-point three biopsies, reflecting distinct tumour composition terms clones distribution.

title: SCOUT cohort
text: SPN06 prototype smoking-associated lung adenocarcinoma, 7 clones compete time two lines treatment. main clonal population driven mutant TP53 STK11 LOH, manifests two subclones: one associated EGFR amplification, one KEAP1 mutation. Upon chemo-immunotherapy (leaves mutational signature), KRAS-driven subclone drives relapse, whereas two subclones eradicated treatment. Upon second line chemotherapy (leave mutational signature), resistance driven aquired amplification mutant KRAS allele last clone WGD. SPN06 profiled three time-points, treatment relapse treatment. two diagnostic biopsies polyclonal, whereas relapse biopsies monoclonal polyclonal.

title: SCOUT cohort
text: SPN07 prototype glioblastoma 6 clones compete time single line treatment. main clonal population driven inactivated PTEN (mutation LOH), manifests two subclones: one associated ATRX1 mutation, one NF1 mutation. Upon chemotherapy timolozomide (causes MSH6 mutation microsatellite instability), resistance achieved hypermutant subclone. Within relapse clone, extra subclone emerges due TP53 mutation. SPN07 profiled two time-points, treatment relapse treatment. three diagnostic two relapse biopsies polyclonal monoclonal.

title: Zenodo
text: get_sarek_results() get_normal_data(), functions return named lists file paths given sample, coverage, purity caller.

title: Zenodo
text: Returns named list VCF index file paths. Supported callers: "mutect2", "strelka", "freebayes", "haplotypecaller". Sample naming convention: "SPN04_1.1".
code: # mutect2 — SPN-level result, no sample needed vcf <- get_sarek_vcf("SPN04", NULL, 100, 0.3, "mutect2") vcf$vcf vcf$tbi  # strelka — one somatic VCF vcf <- get_sarek_vcf("SPN04", "SPN04_1.1", 100, 0.3, "strelka") vcf$vcf  # freebayes vcf <- get_sarek_vcf("SPN04", "SPN04_1.1", 100, 0.3, "freebayes") vcf$vcf  # haplotypecaller — normal sample (sample = NULL) vcf <- get_sarek_vcf("SPN04", NULL, 100, 0.3, "haplotypecaller") vcf$vcf

title: Zenodo
text: Returns named list CNA file paths. Supported callers: "ascat", "battenberg", "sequenza", "cnvkit".
code: # ASCAT cna <- get_sarek_cna("SPN04", "SPN04_1.1", 100, 0.3, "ascat") cna$segments cna$purityploidy cna$cnvs  # Battenberg cna <- get_sarek_cna("SPN04", "SPN04_1.1", 100, 0.3, "battenberg") cna$subclones cna$rho_and_psi  # Sequenza cna <- get_sarek_cna("SPN04", "SPN04_1.1", 100, 0.3, "sequenza") cna$segments cna$confints_CP  # CNVkit cna <- get_sarek_cna("SPN04", "SPN04_1.1", 100, 0.3, "cnvkit") cna$cns

title: Zenodo
text: get_tumourevo_results(), functions return named lists file paths. require spn, coverage, purity, vcf_caller ("mutect2" "strelka"), cna_caller ("ascat" "sequenza"). Sample naming convention: "SPN04_1.1".
